name: Kroger Customer Fulfillment Center Monroe OH

fieldNotes.truckGate: Open divided-boulevard entrance off Hamilton Lebanon Rd with a landscaped median and monument sign; no barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or pinch-point checkpoint at the property line in 2025-07 Street View or 2026 Maxar satellite. Property is ringed by a continuous white perimeter wall/fence and internal one-way painted lane circulation, but the entry itself is uncontrolled.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth at the truck entrance. The small white ancillary building inside the SE yard is a maintenance/utility structure beside a fenced screened equipment enclosure (refrigeration/generator/solar grid), not a multi-window guard booth set beside a gate.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no controlled truck gate at all; an automated CFC like this manages dock scheduling via app rather than a physical checkpoint, but no kiosk/call-box is visible to confirm remote check-in.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved internal yard and circulation roadway between the entrance and the east-face docks gives ample interior holding room.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long divided entrance boulevard plus deep internal yard can stack well over 3 trucks before the dock face.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Generous unused paved apron width at the entrance boulevard and across the east yard; room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted ~18-22 dock positions / trailers backed along the east building face at z20; reported as 10-25 band. Single dock cluster, no separate ship/receive banks.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Two-plus rows of marked angled trailer stalls along the east yard hold ~25-35 trailers without tractors; reported 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated marked drop-trailer rows east of the building, separate from the active dock apron.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town / rural setting: two-lane Hamilton Lebanon Rd frontage with open farmland directly across the road; broader area is industrial-park-on-farmland, not dense metro.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh pad visible in the truck path.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Derived from the traced perimeter polygon (~41 acres of the ~68-acre parcel that is fenced/developed).

citations.claim: Kroger and Ocado to keep operating CFCs in Ohio; Monroe (flagship OH CFC) not among the closures.
Active Kroger CFC jobs at 6266 Hamilton Lebanon Rd, Monroe OH; facility actively hiring.

verification.rationale: Flagship OH CFC explicitly named among RETAINED sites in Dec 2025 pullback; actively hiring 2026.
